description: This file contains unit tests for the ResultFactory class in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.things.persistence.actors.strategies.commands package, specifically testing the notification of different Result types in the context of Thing events and commands.

classes.name: ResultFactoryTest
classes.description: Unit test class verifying the behavior of ResultFactory methods and their interaction with ResultVisitor in different scenarios.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ResultFactory class instances are immutable.

methods.name: notifyQueryResponse
methods.description: Tests that a query result correctly notifies the mock ResultVisitor with onQuery.

methods.name: notifyException
methods.description: Tests that an error result notifies the ResultVisitor with onError.

methods.name: notifyMutationResponseWithNeitherBecomingDeletedNorCreated
methods.description: Tests mutation result notification when neither becomeCreated nor becomeDeleted is true.

methods.name: notifyMutationResponseWithBecomingCreated
methods.description: Tests mutation result notification when becomeCreated is true.

methods.name: notifyMutationResponseWithBecomingDeleted
methods.description: Tests mutation result notification when becomeDeleted is true.

methods.name: assertNotifyMutationResponse
methods.description: Helper method to verify correct notification for mutation results with specified becoming states.
